title: OpenAI proposes perplexity as a common metric for measuring advances and safety in AI
content_md:
OpenAI proposes perplexity as a common metric for measuring advances and safety in AI. Jakub Pachocki argues that perplexity should be a shared measure for tracking pre-training and guiding AI safety standards.

via Mastodon https://guiadeti.com.br/noticias/openai-propoe-metrica-comum-perplexidade-avancos-seguranca-ia/
exclude_reason: AI metric opinion piece, not a security event.
